venue.name: Cedar Coast Field Station
venue.description: Cedar Coast Field Station has no working website. The address listed for it, cedarcoastfieldstation.org, no longer belongs to the organisation: as of September 2026 the domain has been taken over by an unrelated online gambling operator, and every page on it, including the old programme and contact pages, now loads that operator's landing page instead. No other official website for the organisation could be found. Because nothing the organisation itself publishes is reachable, no programme, price, age range, address or access detail could be recorded here.

gaps: DO NOT RE-RUN THIS VENUE AGAINST cedarcoastfieldstation.org. The domain no longer belongs to Cedar Coast Field Station. Every path on it, including /about/, /visit/, /contact/, /programs/ and the one URL left in its sitemap, now returns a single Indonesian-language online gambling landing page titled 'KOITOTO - Bandar Togel Online 4D Terbaik dengan Bayaran Lunas', served with assets from imgmahasuhu.io and mahasuhu.sgp1.digitaloceanspaces.com and a robots.txt written in Indonesian. A browser re-run will render that page, not a field station. Nothing on that domain may be used as a source for this record.
this is NOT a JavaScript rendering problem, so the usual browser escalation does not apply; the domain has changed hands and the venue's own content is gone from it

no other live official website for the organisation was found; the only candidate, cedarcoastsociety.org, is itself a parked domain that redirects every path through router.parklogic.com and publishes no content
no address is published anywhere on a site the organisation controls, so there is nothing to geocode; lat, lng and geo_source are all null rather than geocode_pending
no category could be assigned, because assigning one would rest on the venue's name and the tracker row rather than on anything the organisation publishes

how groups reach the station is unknown. It is described elsewhere as a remote island site reached by boat, but that is a third-party claim and no first-party source states the crossing, who runs it, how long it takes or what it costs
youngest age welcomed is unknown, and for a boat-access island site this is the first thing a daycare director needs settled
whether the organisation still hosts children's groups at all is unknown; no first-party source confirms or denies it
price, capacity, lead time, lunch space, washrooms and rain backup are all unknown, because no page the organisation controls could be read
no images could be collected, so there is no hero image; the only images reachable on the old domain belong to the gambling operator now using it and are not eligible

third-party listings for this venue do exist (a tourism board directory, a field-trip directory, a regional partner page). They were deliberately not used as sources, and the numbers they carry are likely to predate the organisation losing its website
